findings.description: Oversized header hid the first message behind the composer at a short desktop viewport.
findings.resolution: Compacted topic, context strip and review spacing; final 1280x720 observation: first message bottom 470.984375, composer top 521.703125; Safari screenshot shows full first message.

findings.description: Two-line desktop hero reduced the visible discussion above the composer.
findings.resolution: Compacted desktop topic and spacing, preserving mobile composition and decision rail; final 1280x720 observation: first message bottom 516.1640625, composer top 525.8515625; Safari screenshot confirms.

findings.description: Use transcript returned focus to the microphone instead of the editable composer.
findings.resolution: Dialog return target now points to message; browser recheck confirmed focus=message and transcript retained.

findings.description: Always-visible review selectors competed with the mobile discussion.
findings.resolution: Moved review selectors into native collapsed Review states disclosure.
